description:
UPFRONT's own listings for one event ranked by where the seats are,
not only by price: "best view for 2 under $250", "closest seats to
the court for $400 total", "seats in the shade", "not too high up".
event_id is UPFRONT's event id (eventId in event results).

prefer: "closest" (nearest the field, court or stage; the default),
"lowest" (lowest eye height), "covered" (rows a deck or roof
overhead reaches well past, straight up and 30 degrees out toward
the field and to either side, first; for shade or rain, though wind
can still blow rain in) or "value" (the best mix of closeness and
price).
quantity: the number of tickets needed together. max_price: per
ticket, fees included. max_total_price: the whole group's budget,
with quantity.
limit: how many picks (default 5, at most 10).

Each pick has the section, row, all-in price (and total for the
quantity), the row's distance and height, whether it's covered, the
section's view picture (UPFRONT's 3D view, not a photo), its
section page, why it was picked, and url, the link to buy exactly
that listing.

placed says how many of the matching listings could be put on the
seating chart; only those are ranked. hasFacts false means UPFRONT
has no seat facts for this venue, so the picks are simply the
cheapest and the ranking is by price only. {"error":
"search_failed"} means the listings lookup failed, not that nothing
is on sale.
name: best_seats
title: Best seats by view
